description: box [0,0,0]–[40,30,10] minus a cylinder r 3 at (3, 15) from z 4 to 16: a blind hole whose wall touches the face x = 0 from inside along the ruling x = 0, y = 15, z 4…10, interior to the face and to the wall. The result would need the two faces to share a slit; Open CASCADE builds it with the ruling as an edge of four faces (12/19/9/11, an Euler count that reads as genus 1, so no analytic genus here), Arris refuses with OpError::Degenerate and Reason::TangentContact naming the pair (plan m4-booleans ⚠ OPEN 1)
